info.name: NY Rental Mid-Ride Stops (Bangalore, Auto Rickshaw)
info.description:
Rider changes stops while a rental ride is in progress (updateStops):
  Driver onboard -> Rider auth -> Rental search -> Confirm -> Driver accepts -> Driver starts ->
  add A, B -> old version refused -> add C before B -> moving next stop A refused with the driver 800 m from it ->
  driver 4 km away: A moved behind C -> far-away arrival refused -> arrive C -> out-of-turn arrival refused ->
  arrive A, B -> single-stop add refused -> end ride.

Needs rider_config.enable_rental_stop_updates = true for the city (see dev/local-testing-data/rental-mid-ride-stops.sql).
Onboarding to start comes from the rental collection removed in 3f8663259d.

item.name: Rider Booking (Version 1: A next, then B)

exec: console.log('stopsVersion', d.stopsVersion, 'rentalStops', JSON.stringify(stops.map(function (s) { return {id: s.location.id, lat: s.location.lat, lon: s.location.lon, reachedAt: s.reachedAt}; })));

function at(stop, letter) { return Math.abs(stop.location.lat - parseFloat(pm.environment.get('stop_' + letter + '_lat'))) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(stop.location.lon - parseFloat(pm.environment.get('stop_' + letter + '_lon'))) < 1e-6; }
pm.test('Two stops: A then B', function () { pm.expect(stops).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(at(stops[0], 'a')).to.be.true; pm.expect(at(stops[1], 'b')).to.be.true; });
